title: Signs Point to Bad Bunny Closing World Tour With Puerto Rico Shows at Hiram Bithorn — Still Unconfirmed
detail: Speculation intensifies that Bad Bunny will close out the Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour with a homecoming run at Estadio Hiram Bithorn in San Juan. San Juan Mayor Miguel Romero confirmed Rimas Entertainment has reserved stadium dates spanning August 21–23, 2026, though he stressed he could not confirm the booking is for Bad Bunny specifically, since Rimas represents other acts as well. On August 12, T-Mobile teased a 'Magenta Pass' offering exclusive access to an unnamed event at the Hiram Bithorn — building on its prior sponsorship of Bad Bunny's 2025 Coliseo residency — while Medalla Light and CeraVe also rolled out tie-in promotion, and heavy construction/staging activity was visible at the stadium. A source close to Bad Bunny's team cited by El Nuevo Día said the plan is for three shows (Aug 21–22, with a possible Aug 23 add depending on demand) to close the tour in Puerto Rico, where it originally launched November 21, 2025. As of this writing, neither Bad Bunny nor Rimas Entertainment has issued an official announcement, exact dates, or ticket on-sale.
